excerpts.author: poojaranjan
excerpts.content:
I prefer following the process rather than skipping a step. There is no required wait time between `Review` and `Last Call`, so once you create the PR and it passes all the bot checks, it would only require editor approval to move forward. That can be done within an EIP Editing Office Hour, if not sooner.

> We can do a shorter timeframe
There is no precedence of a shorter `Last Call` to my knowledge. I suggest a "Call for Input". 

I personally think following the existing process is both the cleaner and shorter option.
